rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it is somewhat equivocal about expansion/hatching despite provided 4AA hatching grade and makes cautious TE/zona comments that are not strongly image-grounded.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrial thickness, male factor diagnosis, BMI, first-cycle status, sperm parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with prognosis tied to morphology and patient factors; minor tension exists between calling the embryo 4AA/hatching and describing it as not dramatically expanded.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and caution about overinterpreting one failed transfer; minor overreach includes speculative comments on sperm DNA fragmentation and optional add-ons.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, expectation setting, and future-cycle planning, including SET, lifestyle optimization, when not to overinvestigate, and what to review if failure occurs.
